taxonomy.URGENT: Blocks a direct next execution/evidence gate.
taxonomy.NECESSARY: Required for structural correctness or reproducibility.
taxonomy.IMPORTANT: Materially improves coherence, provenance or coverage.
taxonomy.PREVIOUSLY_UNCOVERED: A relevant path existed but prior tests did not exercise it.
taxonomy.ABORTED_EXTERNAL_BLOCK: An execution was attempted and stopped by an external/infrastructure blocker.
taxonomy.SUGGESTED: Useful next mechanism not yet required by the current proof path.
taxonomy.CENSORED: Never infer this classification without direct evidence; default TOKEN_VAZIO_NO_EVIDENCE.

closure_contract.rule: No gap becomes CLOSED solely from configuration, merge, memory or narrative.
closure_contract.reopen: A falsifier, contradictory provider state or regression may reopen a closed gap append-only.
